cohort: Primiparous patients who underwent a first vaginal delivery with either mediolateral or lateral episiotomy between April 1, 2010 and March 31, 2012.
finding: Anal incontinence was comparable between primiparous patients who underwent mediolateral or lateral episiotomy, but fecal urgency and de novo fecal urgency were more prevalent among those who underwent lateral episiotomies at 6 months postpartum.
mod_finding: The study directly compared outcomes following two different types of episiotomy (mediolateral vs. lateral) performed during vaginal delivery.
